## Activity

This report summarises activity at Hill Counties Health Centre during December 2019. The site recorded 48 captures during the reporting period. These figures provide the basis for the image-quality and grading information set out below. The activity total is presented as recorded for the site and month, without adjustment or further interpretation.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 2 ungradable captures. The recorded ungradable rate was 4.2. This measure is reported alongside the total capture activity to show the proportion of images that could not be used for grading. The ungradable result is retained as part of the overall site record for December 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results. The median lag was 1. This provides the summary measure of the interval associated with grading for the reporting period. Together, the referable result count and median lag describe the grading position for Hill Counties Health Centre in December 2019. The figures above are presented as the site’s recorded activity, image-quality outcome, and grading outcome for the month.
